declarations.name: SceneView
declarations.comment: The view to present your SCNScene nodes in.

members.name: init
members.signature: @MainActor @preconcurrency init(scene: SCNScene? = nil, pointOfView: SCNNode? = nil, options: SceneView.Options = [], preferredFramesPerSecond: Int = 60, antialiasingMode: SCNAntialiasingMode = .multisampling4X, delegate: (any SCNSceneRendererDelegate)? = nil, technique: SCNTechnique? = nil)
members.comment:
Creates an instance with the given `scene`

- Parameters:
    - scene: SCNScene to present
    - pointOfView: The point of view to use to render the scene.
    - options: Various options (see above) to configure the receiver.
    - preferredFramesPerSecond: sets fps to define the desired rate for current SceneView.
    Actual rate maybe limited by hardware or other software
    - antialiasingMode: desired level of antialiasing. Defaults to 4X.
    - delegate: The delegate of the receiver
    - technique: Specifies a custom post process

declarations.name: SceneView.Body
declarations.comment:
The type of view representing the body of this view.

When you create a custom view, Swift infers this type from your
implementation of the required ``View/body-swift.property`` property.

declarations.name: SceneView.Options
declarations.comment: Option set that's used to customize how the SceneView behaves

members.name: jitteringEnabled
members.comment:
Specifies whether the receiver should jitter the rendered scene to reduce aliasing artifacts.
The default is false.

members.name: allowsCameraControl
members.comment:
Toggles whether the view allows the user to manipulate the camera with gestures or mouse
Defaults to false.

members.name: rendersContinuously
members.comment:
Toggles whether the view renders continuously at the desired frame rate.
If set to false the view will redraw only when necessary.
Defaults to false.

members.name: autoenablesDefaultLighting
members.comment:
Specifies whether the receiver should automatically light up scenes that have no light source.
The default is false.

members.name: temporalAntialiasingEnabled
members.comment:
Specifies whether the receiver should reduce aliasing artifacts in real time based on temporal coherency.
The default is false.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a new option set from the given raw value.

This initializer always succeeds, even if the value passed as `rawValue`
exceeds the static properties declared as part of the option set. This
example creates an instance of `ShippingOptions` with a raw value beyond
the highest element, with a bit mask that effectively contains all the
declared static members.

    let extraOptions = ShippingOptions(rawValue: 255)
    print(extraOptions.isStrictSuperset(of: .all))
    // Prints "true"

- Parameter rawValue: The raw value of the option set to create. Each bit
  of `rawValue` potentially represents an element of the option set,
  though raw values may include bits that are not defined as distinct
  values of the `OptionSet` type.

declarations.comment: The type of the elements of an array literal.

declarations.name: SceneView.Options.Element
declarations.comment:
The element type of the option set.

To inherit all the default implementations from the `OptionSet` protocol,
the `Element` type must be `Self`, the default.

declarations.name: SceneView.Options.RawValue
declarations.comment:
The raw type that can be used to represent all values of the conforming
type.

Every distinct value of the conforming type has a corresponding unique
value of the `RawValue` type, but there may be values of the `RawValue`
type that don't have a corresponding value of the conforming type.
